blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video understanding benchmarks are the primary yardstick for measuring progress in video-language modeling, and a growing body of work relies on them to claim improvements. The reported benchmark scores in these works, however, are almost always produced by frameworks (e.g., lmms eval) used as black boxes: certain evaluation choices like frame sampling, preprocessing, and input formatting are inherited from preset defaults and seldom inspected carefully. We show these unexamined choices are a major source of variance. Even for the same model checkpoint, evaluation configuration alone can shift accuracy by up to 19.5pp. Hence, it is unclear whether reported gains reflect genuine improvements in capability or differences in evaluation setup. Moreover, many benchmark samples offer little evidence of visual capability, since they can be answered without the video, and the full suites are expensive to evaluate. We address these issues in two parts. First, we curate existing suites for discriminability and efficiency, producing Meta-Video, a balanced 1,000-question benchmark over 791 videos spanning diverse tasks and durations, which largely preserves model rankings, at 5 times inference speedup for a full-frame count sweep experiment (4-128 frames). Second, we establish a standardized evaluation protocol by sweeping the configuration space to isolate choices that measurably affect results, distill them into best practices and reporting standards, and release reproducible reference scores across five models and seven benchmarks. We hope that the proposed evaluation framework and the Meta-Video benchmark will support video understanding research by providing a reproducible and efficient foundation to measure progress in a reliable way.
blocks.zh: 视频理解基准是衡量视频语言建模进展的主要尺度,越来越多的工作依赖于这些基准来要求改进。 然而,这些作品中所报告的基准分数几乎总是由用作黑匣子的框架(例如lmms eval)产生:某些评价选择,如框架采样,预处理,以及输入格式化,都是从预设默认中继承出来的,很少仔细检查. 我们显示,这些未经审查的选择是造成差异的主要原因。 即使同一型号的检查点,光是评价配置就可以改变准确度,最高可达19.5pp. 因此,目前还不清楚所报告的成果是否反映了能力的真正提高,还是评价结构的不同。 此外,许多基准样本很少提供视觉能力的证据,因为没有视频可以解答,而全套套房的评价成本也很高. 我们分两部分处理这些问题。 首先,我们对现有套房进行区分和效率管理,制作Meta-Video,一个平衡的1000个问题基准,超过791个涉及不同任务和持续时间的视频,这在很大程度上保留了模型排名,为全帧倒数扫描实验(4-128帧)的5倍推算速度. 第二,我们建立标准评价协议,将配置空间扫出,以隔离对成果有重大影响的选择,将它们提炼成最佳做法和报告标准,并在五个模式和七个基准中公布可复制的参考分数。 我们希望,拟议的评价框架和Meta-Video基准将支持视频理解研究,为可靠地衡量进展情况提供一个可复制和高效的基础。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Benchmarks measure progress in video understanding, with researchers often using benchmark scores to claim improvements over prior methods or base models. Such claims assume that scores for the same checkpoint on the same benchmark are fairly comparable across evaluations and papers. We find that they are not. Table 1 compares scores reported in recent papers for two widely used checkpoints, Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 5 ] and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 4 ] , across 11 video benchmarks. Several methods report gains over the Qwen2.5-VL-7B baseline that fall below our reproduction of the same baseline. When we evaluate these methods under identical settings, they don’t improve consistently over the baseline across varying frame counts. We see that reported performance varies substantially across papers by up to 19.5pp on VideoMME on the same checkpoint.
These differences far exceed the 2–5pp gains commonly showcased by these same papers over the base model. This makes it hard to tell whether an apparent gain claimed in these prior works, stems from a real capability improvement in the model, a difference in evaluation configuration, or both.

blocks.en:
This shows that video evaluation can be especially sensitive to eval configuration. For example, Frame sampling determines which events are visible to a model.
Which Video decoder is used, how Number of frames and Frame resolution are set determine the detail and temporal structure visible to the model.
Further, the Input modality (input a video file or sequence of frames) and text Prompt can also affect performance.
Yet, papers use evaluation frameworks like lmms_eval as black boxes , leaving such details underspecified. Additionally, the quality of benchmark samples can affect the value and cost of evaluation. Some benchmark samples can be answered without even seeing the video.
Further, because model rankings can differ across benchmarks, robust comparisons demand aggregating evaluations on multiple datasets, with very large inference costs.
As such, a reliable evaluation supporting fast model development calls for 1 a clean set of benchmark samples, 2 low evaluation cost while preserving ranking, and 3 a standardized evaluation protocol.

blocks.en:
To address 1 and 2 , we introduce Meta-Video (Sec. 3 ), a compact video understanding benchmark of 1,000 questions over 791 videos, balanced across source datasets and spanning diverse tasks and durations. We construct it by filtering out low-quality samples to further improve evaluation fidelity and computational efficiency [ 28 , 23 ] . Specifically, we remove questions solvable without the video, since these cannot measure video understanding. Meta-Video largely preserves model rankings over its source benchmarks, separates models more sharply, and requires 5 × 5\times less inference compute than the reference benchmarks for a full sweep over frame counts, which is the most expensive evaluation setting (Table 2 (b)).
To tackle 3 , we identify key parameters in video evaluation pipelines and systematically measure their effects on performance (Sec. 4 ).
We find that input representation and inference backend substantially change scores.
In particular, switching between vLLM and Hugging Face while keeping their respective default settings can change performance by more than 5pp, with gains decreasing once the defaults are fixed.
Further, we show that extracted .jpg frames yield higher scores when few frames are sampled, while .mp4 input performs better with larger frame budgets.
We observe that how many frames and which frames (frame sampling) the model sees is one of the largest, most consistent factors influencing performance.
Our systematic evaluation identifies the major impact factors and proposes a concise way to compile them in the form of evaluation cards to allow for a better, transparent, and reproducible practice in video understanding benchmarking.
blocks.zh:
为了处理第1和第2个问题,我们介绍了Meta-Video(第3节),这是一个精密的视频理解基准,涵盖1 000个问题,超过791个视频,在源数据集之间实现平衡,并涵盖不同的任务和期限。 我们通过过滤出低质量的样本来构建它,以进一步提高评价的忠诚度和计算效率[28,23]. 具体地说,我们删除了没有录像可解的问题,因为这些无法衡量录像的理解。 Meta-Video在很大程度上保留了模型相对于其源基准的排名,将模型分开得更尖锐,并且需要5×5\次的推论计算,比全面浏览帧数的参考基准要少,这是最昂贵的评价设定(表2(b)).
为了解决3个问题,我们确定了视频评价管道的关键参数,并系统地衡量其对业绩的影响(第4节)。
我们认为,这种投入说明和推论的后端有很大的改变。
特别是,在保持各自默认设置的同时在vLLM和Hugging Face之间切换,可以改变超过5pp的性能,一旦默认被固定,收益会减少.
此外,我们显示,提取出.jpg帧的得分较高,因为抽样的帧很少,而.mp4输入则在更大的帧预算下表现更好。
我们注意到,模型看到多少帧和哪些帧(帧抽样)是影响性能的最大、最一致的因素之一。
我们的系统评价确定了主要的影响因素,并提出了以评价卡的形式汇编这些因素的简明方法,以便在视频理解基准方面采取更好、透明和可复制的做法。

blocks.en:
Together, our contributions are:
(1) We introduce Meta-Video , a compact, balanced benchmark that preserves ranking trends across its source benchmarks (reliability), uses one-fifth of the inference compute for a full frame-count sweep (efficiency), and makes differences between models clearer (discriminability).
(2) We examine the current state of video understanding evaluation and show that variation in often unspecified evaluation protocols can explain substantial discrepancies in reported scores.
(3) We release a revised evaluation suite and an extensive set of reference configurations to improve reproducibility and support future comparisons.
We hope our findings and standardized evaluation protocols offer a transparent and less costly way to evaluate video understanding, in a reliable manner.

(2)我们审视视频理解评价的现状,并表明,经常未说明的评价协议的差异可以解释报告得分的巨大差异。
(3) 我们发布了一套经修订的评价套件和一套广泛的参考配置,以提高可复制性并支持今后的比较。
我们希望,我们的调查结果和标准化的评价协议为以可靠方式评价视频理解提供了透明和成本较低的方法。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Video Understanding Models. General purpose vision-language models have the capability to ingest multi-frame input and hence can perform video understanding tasks. Models such as Qwen2.5-VL [ 5 ] , InternVL [ 80 ] , LLaVA-OneVision [ 30 , 2 , 1 ] , PerceptionLM [ 11 ] , Molmo [ 14 ] , LLaVA-Next-Interleave [ 31 ] etc., are widely used as standard open-weight VLMs. Other works enable such models to interpret and reason over dynamic visual content [ 51 , 10 , 66 , 8 , 33 , 73 , 41 , 42 , 69 , 79 ] . More recently, video reasoning models have surfaced with the ability to reason over temporal and causal relationships across sequences of frames [ 44 , 63 , 52 , 74 , 59 ] .
blocks.zh: 视频理解模型. 通用视觉语言模型具有吸收多框架输入的能力,因此可以执行视频理解任务. 例如: Quen2.5-VL [5], InternVL [80], LLaVA- One Visiion [30, 2, 1], PerceptionLM [11], Molmo [14], LLaVA-Next-Interleave [31]等模型被广泛用作标准的开量VLM. 其他作品使这些模型能够比动态视觉内容解释和理性[51、10、66、8、33、73、41、42、69、79]。 最近,视频推理模型浮出水面,能够跨帧序列进行时间和因果关系的推理[44、63、52、74、59]。

blocks.en: Video Understanding Benchmarks. Multiple benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate video understanding e.g., VideoMME [ 21 ] , LongVideoBench [ 65 ] , MVBench [ 32 ] , LVBench [ 61 ] etc. Further, several benchmarks target reasoning, such as, VideoMMMU [ 26 ] , VideoMathQA [ 50 ] , SciVideoBench [ 15 ] , VideoReasonBench [ 38 ] , VCRBench [ 49 ] , TempCompass [ 37 ] , MMVU [ 76 ] , MLVU [ 78 ] , Minerva [ 46 ] , EgoSchema [ 43 ] etc. However, these benchmarks have key limitations [ 57 , 70 ] . For e.g., many questions can be answered without any visual information [ 22 ] , as we show in Sec. A . In addition, because of their large size, evaluation is extremely time-consuming, discouraging rapid iteration for fast model development.
blocks.zh: 视频理解基准. 提出了多项基准来评价视频理解,例如:VideoMME [21],LongVideo Bench [65],MV Bench [32],LV Bench [61]等. 此外,若干基准目标推理,如VideoMMMU [26],VideoMathQA [50],SciVideo Bench [15],VideoReason Bench [38],VCR Bench [49],TempCompass [37],MMVU [76],MLVU [78],Minerva [46],EgoSchema [43]等。 然而,这些基准有关键的局限性[57、70]。 例如,正如我们在Sec.A.中所示,许多问题可以在没有任何视觉信息的情况下得到回答。 此外,由于评价规模很大,评价极其耗时,不利于快速迭代以快速模型开发。

blocks.en:
Validity of Benchmark Evaluations. Recent works have tried to improve the validity of benchmarks. Answer-Matching [ 6 ] reformulates multiple-choice tasks into a generative setting, MMBench [ 36 ] uses circular evaluation techniques, VMCBench automatically scales up question generation process [ 75 ] , OneBench proposes aggregating heteregeneous measurements across benchmarks [ 23 ] , and DataComp-VLM [ 18 ] uses stability-monotonicity filtering. DatBench [ 28 ] proposed a cleaned evaluation suite that expedites evaluation and maintains discriminative power. Sober Reasoning [ 25 ] provides an empirical evaluation of mathematical reasoning benchmarks showcasing sensitivity to various implementation choices like random seed, prompt formatting, and hardware configurations.
All these prior works focus mainly on language and image domains, with the video domain taking a back seat.
Further, evaluation repositories such as lmms_eval [ 72 ] and VLMEvalKit [ 16 ] provide a framework to evaluate various multimodal benchmarks with multiple models. However, they are often used as black boxes, which makes results hard to compare.
We close this gap with a standardized evaluation protocol for video and a new benchmark, Meta-Video , built for discriminability and fast iteration.

blocks.en: Evaluating video models across multiple benchmarks and configurations to ensure robustness is expensive, particularly for researchers with limited compute. Reliable comparisons also require questions that test video understanding: questions that models can answer without visual input can inflate scores and obscure differences between models. To address these problems, we introduce Meta-Video , a compact benchmark of videos and question-answer pairs selected from existing datasets, while reducing inference cost.
blocks.zh: 评估跨多个基准和配置的视频模型以确保稳健性是昂贵的,特别是对计算有限的研究人员而言。 可靠的比较还需要测试视频理解的问题:模型在没有视觉输入的情况下能够回答的问题可以提高分数并模糊模型之间的差异. 为了解决这些问题,我们采用了Meta-Video,这是从现有数据集中选择的视频和问答对的紧凑基准,同时降低推论成本.

blocks.en: 3.1 Source Benchmarks and Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 来源基准和建筑

blocks.en: We select video QA pairs from the evaluation sets of Video-MME, LongVideoBench, LVBench, and VideoMMMU, and VSI-Bench (subset of 200 QA pairs), which cover a range of video types, durations, and question categories. To filter questions that may be answerable without visual input, we replace all frames with black frames and evaluate Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, and InternVL3.5-8B. We discard each question that at least two or more models answer correctly, then sample QA pairs from the remaining questions in each source benchmark (see Appendix A for details).

blocks.en: 4 Standardizing Evaluations for Video Understanding
blocks.zh: 4 视频理解评价标准化

blocks.en: Evaluation choices can change both model scores and rankings. We examine these choices at multiple stages: inference and decoding (Sec. 4.1 ), frame extraction (Sec. 4.2 ), model input (Sec. 4.3 ), and prompt design (Sec. 5.2 ). Based on this, we fix the most influential factors to obtain a reproducible evaluation protocol (Sec. 4.4 ), while documenting detailed configurations in evaluation cards. Finally, we provide comprehensive evaluations across seven benchmarks and five models (Sec. 5.1 ).

blocks.en: 4.1 Inference and decoding
blocks.zh: 4.1 推论和解码

blocks.en: Inference backend. Video question-answering frameworks such as lmms_eval support multiple inference backends, including the reference Hugging Face (HF) implementation [ 27 ] and optimized engines such as vLLM [ 29 ] . These backends can differ in both numerical computation and preprocessing. In our experiments, HF produces identical scores across repeated runs with fixed seeds, whereas vLLM exhibits significant variations even with fixed seeds, potentially due to batching.
blocks.zh: 推论后端. lmms_eval等视频问答框架支持多个推论后端,包括参考Hugging Face(HF)执行 [27] 并优化了vLLM [29]等引擎. 这些后端在数字计算和预处理上都可能有所不同. 在我们的实验中,高频在使用固定种子的反复运行中产生相同的分数,而vLLM在使用固定种子时也表现出了巨大的变化,可能是因为分批。

blocks.en:
Batch size. Batch composition and size can affect padding and kernel selection, changing outputs even under greedy decoding. Although batch size has little effect on aggregate performance in our experiments, it remains a source of variation and should be reported.
Table 2 (a) compares the impact of inference backends and batch sizes. Scores within each framework are stable, with a mean standard deviation of 0.15 0.15 percentage points, but scores between backends differ by 4 4 – 6 6 points on TempCompass, MVBench, and Meta-Video . On Meta-Video , for example, the same model scores approximately 24 % 24\% with HF and 30 % 30\% with vLLM. We find that this discrepancy is attributable to the evaluated vLLM implementation converting video inputs into individual images, bypassing the Qwen models’ spatiotemporal pooling. We provide a fix lmms_eval_video implementation that restores this pooling and aligns vLLM preprocessing with HF. Appendix A describes the fix and its results.
blocks.zh:
批量尺寸. 批量的构成和大小会影响地垫和内核选择,即使在贪婪的解码下也会改变输出. 虽然批量规模对我们的实验中的总性能影响不大,但它仍然是变化的来源,应该加以报告。
表2(a)比较了推断后端和批量尺寸的影响。 每个框架中的得分都稳定,平均标准差为0.15克0.15分,但后端之间的得分在TempCompass,MV Bench,和Meta-Video上的得分相差了4分4分6分. 例如,在Meta-Video上,同一型号与高频的分数约为24%-24分,而VLLM的分数约为30%-30分. 我们发现这种差异可归因于被评价的 vLLM 执行将视频输入转换为单个图像,绕过Quen 模型的spatiotemporion 集合. 我们提供一个固定的 lmms_eval_video 执行, 它恢复了这个集合, 并将 vLLM 预处理与 HF 同步 。 附 录 A描述了定律及其结果.

blocks.en: 4.2 Frame extraction
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 框架提取

blocks.en: Number of frames and Frame sampling. The number of input frames determines how much of a video the model sees and has one of the largest effects on accuracy. Uniform sampling selects exactly N N frames from a video of duration T T , independent of T T , so temporal coverage becomes sparser as duration T T increases. Fixed-rate sampling at r r frames per second selects approximately r ​ T rT frames, maintaining temporal density while allocating more frames to longer videos.
blocks.zh: 帧和帧采样数量. 输入帧的数量决定了一个模型所看到的视频的多少,并对准确度产生最大的影响之一. 统一采样从TT持续时间的视频中选择精确的N N帧,独立于TT,因此随着T持续时间的增加,时间覆盖范围会变得更稀少. 每秒r帧的固定速率采样选择了大约r T rT帧,保持了时间密度,同时将更多的帧分配给更长的视频.

blocks.en: We find that the evaluated lmms_eval implementation exposes a maximum frame count, N max N_{\max} , but its backends do not enforce it, which can cause out-of-memory errors on long videos. Our implementation enforces this limit: when it is set, the model receives min ⁡ ( ⌊ r ​ T ⌋ , N max ) \min(\lfloor rT\rfloor,N_{\max}) frames. If ⌊ r ​ T ⌋ ≥ N max \lfloor rT\rfloor\geq N_{\max} , the framework switches to uniform sampling over the full video. Thus, fixed-rate sampling maintains temporal density until the cap is reached. We also support clipping the video based on N max N_{\max} ; Appendix A provides details.

blocks.en: We observe that with uniform sampling, increasing the frame count from 4 to 128 raises accuracy on Video-MME from 50.0 % 50.0\% to 65.5 % 65.5\% and on Meta-Video from 24.80 % 24.80\% to 40.75 % 40.75\% (Table 2 (b)). Gains on TempCompass and MVBench saturate or reverse beyond 64 frames, showing that additional frames do not always improve performance. These results show that frame count is one of the strongest determinants of performance across the tested range of 4 to 128 uniformly sampled frames.
blocks.zh: 我们观察到,通过统一取样,帧数从4个增加到128个,Video-MME的精确度从50.0%(50.0%)提高到65.5%(65.5%),Meta-Video的精确度从24.80%(24.80%)提高到40.75%(表2(b))。 在TempCompass和MV Bench上的收益饱和或倒转超过64帧,表明附加帧并不总是能提高性能. 这些结果显示,框架计数是衡量4至128个统一抽样框架业绩的最强决定因素之一。

blocks.en:
Sampling strategy also affects accuracy (Table 2 (c)). Sampling at 1 fps instead of uniformly has no effect on Video-MME in this comparison. On the shorter clips in TempCompass and MVBench, it reduces both the number of frames and runtime, but lowers accuracy by 3.4 3.4 – 5.0 5.0 pp.
Uniform sampling performs better on average, suggesting that dense sampling can help even on short videos.

blocks.en: Video decoder. Video decoders such as decord [ 13 ] , torchvision [ 56 ] , and torchcodec [ 48 ] can differ in timestamp calculation, variable-frame-rate handling, and keyframe resolution. They may therefore extract different frames under the same sampling settings.
blocks.zh: 视频解码器. 视频解码器,如装饰 [13],火炬视觉 [56],和火炬码c [48] 在时间戳计算,可变帧率处理,和按键帧分辨率方面可以有所不同. 因此,它们可以在相同的取样环境中提取出不同的框架。

blocks.en: In our evaluation, decoder choice changes scores but does not affect the overall model ranking (Table 2 (d)). Decord performs slightly better than torchcodec, while torchvision produces larger drops on some datasets. We use torchcodec, the default in the evaluated lmms_eval implementation, and recommend reporting the decoder to support reproducibility.
blocks.zh: 在我们的评价中,解码器选择会改变分数,但不会影响总体模型排名(表2(d))。 装饰性能略好于火炬codec,而火炬视觉则在一些数据集上产生更大的滴. 我们使用火炬码c,即评价 lmms_eval 执行中的默认,并建议报告解码器以支持可复制性.

blocks.en: Frame resolution. Before tokenization, frames are resized so that their area does not exceed max_pixels . This budget controls spatial details and, for models with dynamic-resolution encoders, the number of visual tokens per frame. Different default budgets can therefore give the same model substantially different inputs at the same frame count.
blocks.zh: 框架分辨率。 标记前, 帧会调整大小, 使其区域不超过最大_ 像素 。 这个预算控制了空间细节,对于拥有动态解析编码器的模型,每个帧的可视化符号数量. 因此,不同的默认预算可以在同一个框架计数时给同样的模型提供大相径庭的投入.

blocks.en: We evaluate the impact of the frame resolution strategy (Table 2 (e)). We observe among the budgets tested, 200,704 200{,}704 pixels yields the highest average accuracy across benchmarks, while 301,056 301{,}056 performs best on Meta-Video (Table 2 (e)). However, the variation is minor and frame resolution does not impact performance significantly.
blocks.zh: 我们评价框架决议战略的影响(表2(e))。 在所测试的预算中,我们看到200 704 200{,}704像素在基准中平均准确度最高,而301 056 301{,}056在Meta-Video上表现最好(表2(e))。 然而,变化不大,框架分辨率不会对业绩产生重大影响。

blocks.en: 4.3 Model input
blocks.zh: 4.3 示范投入

blocks.en:
Input modality. Sampled frames can be supplied as video input or as a sequence of images, and many VLMs process these modalities through different branches. The video branch may apply spatiotemporal pooling, merging patches across frames into shared visual tokens. The pooling scheme depends on the architecture: Qwen2.5-VL pools pairs of frames, producing half as many visual tokens as its image branch. In the implementations we evaluated, HF uses the video branch, whereas vLLM converts video inputs into individual images and bypasses temporal pooling. Appendix A describes our fix.
Table 2 (b) compares direct .mp4 input with pre-extracted .jpg frames. Input modality changes accuracy by 4 4 – 6 6 percentage points in some settings. This recovers the gap between vLLM and HF in Table 2 (a). Image input can perform better at low frame counts, gaining 5.0 5.0 points on TempCompass at four frames, but its gains flatten or reverse at higher frame counts. At 128 frames on MVBench, image input scores 60.6 % 60.6\% , compared with 68.0 % 68.0\% for video input. The lower visual-token count from spatiotemporal pooling may help explain the advantage of video input at larger frame budgets.
blocks.zh:
输入模式。 样本帧可以作为视频输入或图像序列提供,许多VLM通过不同的分支处理这些模式. 视频分支可能应用spatiotemporal集合,将跨帧的补丁合并为共享的视觉符号. 集合计划依赖于架构: Quen2.5-VL集合相框对相框,产生与它的图像分支一样多的可视标志. 在我们评价的实施中,高频使用视频分支,而vLLM将视频输入转换成单个图像并绕过时间集合. 附 录 A描述了我们的定律。
表2(b)将直接的.mp4输入与预取的.jpg帧进行比较. 输入模式在某些设置中会改变精度4 4–6 6个百分点. 这弥补了表2(a)中VLLM和高频之间的差距。 图像输入在低帧计数时表现会更好,在TempCompass上以4帧计得5.0 5.0分,但其增益在较高帧计数时会变平或倒数. 在MV Bench的128帧上,图像输入得分为60.6% 60.6分,而视频输入得分为68.0% 68.0分. 从spatiotemporal 集合中取出更低的可视化键数,可能有助于解释视频输入在较大帧预算中的优势.

blocks.en: Prompt. Evaluation prompts specify both the task and the required answer format, affecting predictions as well as whether those predictions are parsed correctly. Prompt layouts also vary: some place text before or after the video, while others repeat text or visual content to change which earlier inputs each modality can attend to under causal attention, resulting in prompt patterns such as T-V-T or V-T-V. We evaluate these choices in Section 5.2 .
blocks.zh: 快点 评价提示既规定了任务,也规定了所要求的答案格式,影响到预测以及这些预测是否得到正确分析。 即时布局也各有不同:在视频之前或之后有些会放出文字,而另一些会重复文字或视觉内容来改变每种方式在因果注意下可以处理的更早输入,从而产生T-V-T或V-T-V等即时图案. 我们在第5.2节评估这些选择。

blocks.en: Decoding temperature. Sampling temperature affects accuracy even when the prompt requests only a single option letter. Nonzero temperatures introduce stochasticity and can increase variation across runs. We observe from Table 2 (f) that τ = 0 \tau=0 gives the best average accuracy among temperatures we test (except TempCompass and Meta-V which fall within the standard deviation). They also affect some datasets more than others: on Video-MME, accuracy falls from 50.0 % 50.0\% at τ = 0 \tau=0 to 44.9 % 44.9\% at τ = 1 \tau=1 .
blocks.zh: 解码温度。 采样温度影响精度,即使被迅速请求的只是单个选项字母. 非零气温引入了分色性,并且可以增加跨径的变化. 我们从表2(f)中注意到,我们测试的温度(TempCompass和Meta-V属于标准偏差范围除外)中的平均准确度最高。 它们也比其他数据集更能影响一些数据集:在Video-MME上,精度从50.0 % 50.0 = 0\tau=0下降到44.9% 44.9% = 1\tau=1.

blocks.en: 4.4 Best Practices: Evaluation Cards
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 最佳做法:评价卡

blocks.en: As seen in above sections, VLMs are highly sensitive to evaluation choices, but are rarely reported in full. To make evaluations stable and reproducible, we fix a reference configuration and vary one factor, keeping all other settings fixed. Inspired by dataset cards [ 47 ] , we introduce evaluation card that summarizes the complete configuration behind its numbers. For each parameter varied within the table, all the other settings are fixed (Template in Table 3 ). We provide an evaluation card for every table in this paper in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 正如上文各节所显示的,自愿终止措施对评价选择高度敏感,但很少全面报告。 为了使评价保持稳定和可复制,我们确定参考配置,并改变一个因素,使所有其他设置保持不变。 在数据集卡[47]的启发下,我们引入了评价卡来总结其数字背后的完整配置. 对于表格中的每个参数,所有其他设置都是固定的(表3中的模板)。 我们为附录A中本文的每一表提供评价卡。

blocks.en: Our ablations on the effect of different parameters show that evaluation settings can substantially change model scores. We therefore compared the performance of five common open MLLMs while controlling backend, resolution, temperature, and other settings. To assess the best model performance, we vary the frame budget, one of the strongest determinants of performance. This comparison reveals both how well models perform and how they use additional visual input.
blocks.zh: 我们对不同参数的影响的描述表明,评价设置可以大大改变模型的分数。 因此,我们在控制后端、分辨率、温度和其他设置的同时,比较了五个常见的开放的MLLMs的性能。 为了评估最佳模式业绩,我们改变了框架预算,这是业绩的最强有力的决定因素之一。 这种比较揭示出模型的表现如何以及它们如何使用额外的视觉输入.

blocks.en: Setup. We compare models at 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, and 128 frames on seven source benchmarks—Video-MME, LongVideoBench, TempCompass, MMVU, LVBench, and MLVU and VSI-Bench—and on Meta-Video . The models are Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 5 ] , Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 4 ] , and InternVL3.5-4B and InternVL3.5-8B [ 62 ] . Each InternVL3.5 frame is encoded as one tile. Table 11 gives the full evaluation card; scores reported in the original model papers appear in gray.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We propose Meta-Video , a compact video understanding benchmark that is an efficient and reliable version of the source benchmarks. This benchmark helps us to evaluate models efficiently while still keeping the trends of the original benchmarks. We propose an open evaluation framework built on top of lmms_eval for cleaner video understanding
evaluation. We provide an exhaustive evaluation with various configurations on seven benchmarks.
We provide an analysis of the effect of input layout and varying prompts on Meta-Video .
In conclusion, we show that evaluation choices such as frame sampling, input layout, prompt, backend affects video benchmark scores, and are often unreported. We hope the new benchmark and evaluation reporting will help to pave the way towards more transparent, reproducible evaluation in the field.

blocks.en: How .mp4 is processed? For inputs with .mp4, the processor first samples frames based on nframes argument. It then resizes the frames based on the max_pixel. Further, frames are grouped in pairs due to temporal patch size which is specific for videos in Qwen2.5-VL models. Each frame is encoded separately to obtain X v ​ i ​ s ​ i ​ o ​ n X_{vision} tokens per frame, meaning that there are nframes × X v ​ i ​ s ​ i ​ o ​ n \texttt{nframes}\times X_{vision} tokens. Then, for each 2x2 group of adjacent patch embeddings (based on the temporal patch size), a spatial merge happens. The processor inserts <|vision_start|> , then one <|video_pad|> with token id 151656 151656 per merged token, then <|vision_end|> . So the total video tokens is ( nframes 2 ) × H 28 × W 28 (\frac{\texttt{nframes}}{2})\times\frac{H}{28}\times\frac{W}{28} . It also uses M-RoPE with separate temporal, height, and width components.

blocks.en: How .jpg is processed? The wrapper converts the PIL image to data and resize based on max_pixel to multiples of 28. Instead of the true temporal dimension which was added in the case of .mp4 as input, in .jpg, each frame is duplicated, followed by similar path as video processing but since the tokens are duplicated, the total token count become H 28 × W 28 \frac{H}{28}\times\frac{W}{28} with M-RoPE temporal index as constant for all image tokens. The image placeholder id is 151655 151655 .

blocks.en: Similar to .mp4 and .jpg , the choice of inference backend HF vs vLLM also affects results because the two differ in how they process visual inputs. HF backend accepts video natively along with images, whereas vLLM by default, samples frames and encodes the frames as separate images. As a result, there is no spatio-temporal pooling with vLLM , which leads to difference in performance based on the backend used.

blocks.en: A.4 Uniform vs 1fps
blocks.zh: A.4 制服对1fps

blocks.en: As explained in the main paper, we re-implement 1fps as the original lmms_eval lacked the full implementation. We make a design choice when using 1fps. In the original lmms_eval, if the N m ​ a ​ x N_{max} argument was provided, it would ignore it for the cases when the duration of the video was longer than N m ​ a ​ x N_{max} , and would result in out of memory error. Hence, we re-implement this. In our implementation, if the 1fps is used along with N m ​ a ​ x N_{max} argument, all the videos which are less than N m ​ a ​ x N_{max} will be sampled at 1fps, but for the videos longer than N m ​ a ​ x N_{max} , a fallback of uniform N m ​ a ​ x N_{max} is done. One other way to implement this is by clipping all the frames that come after N m ​ a ​ x N_{max} . By doing so, we might end up not seeing the full video, and it could happen that the question asked is from the part of the video which was clipped off. Due to this issue we decided on using uniform N m ​ a ​ x N_{max} sampling as the fallback. To support this claim, on randomly sampled 100 videos from VideoMME long subset, we perform the clipped version vs uniform sampled version. The uniform sampled version with N m ​ a ​ x N_{max} =32 obtains 49.33 49.33 score whereas the clipped version obtains 47.33 47.33 score which is 2.0 2.0 points lower. Hence we decided on uniform sampled version as the fallback. With 64 frames the uniform version is 52.33 52.33 score, whereas with the clipped version, we get 50.0 50.0 as score.
blocks.zh: 如主要论文所解释,我们重新执行1fps,因为原始的lmms_eval缺乏充分执行. 我们在使用1fps时做出设计选择. 在原始 lmms_eval 中,如果提供了 N m a x N_{max} 参数,那么对于视频持续时间长于 N m a × N_{max} 的情况,它会忽略它,并会导致内存出错. 因此,我们重新落实了这一点。 如果1fps与 N m a x N_{max} 参数一起使用, 所有小于 N m a x N_{max} 的视频将在 1fps 进行采样, 但对于长于 N m a x N_{max} 的视频, 则完成 uniform N m a x N_{max} 的倒置 。 另一种执行方式是剪接N m a x N_{max 后的所有帧 。 问的问题可能来自被剪掉的影片。 由于这个问题,我们决定使用统一 N m a x N_{max] 采样作为倒计时。 为了支持这一说法,我们随机抽取了VideoMME长子集的100个视频,执行被剪辑的版本与统一的样本版本。 使用 N m a x N_{max} = 32 的统一抽样版本获得49.33 49.33分,而被剪辑的版本获得47.33 47.33分,比2.0 分低。 因此,我们决定采用统一的样本版本作为倒计时。 使用64帧,统一版为52.33 52.33分,而使用剪接版,我们得到50.0 500.0分。

In Figure 1 , we show the statistics about our Meta-V dataset. Meta-V contains 1000 QA pairs on 788 unique videos (but 791 distinct videos in total), which are obtained from five source benchmarks. The source benchmarks are: VideoMME, LongVideoBench, LVBench, VideoMMMU, and VSIBench. In order to get a cleaner set of QA pairs, we first do a blind filtering. blocks.en: Recently, a lot of effort in video understanding community has shifted towards building better video reasoning models. Video-R1 [ 19 ] introduces a T-GRPO algorithm, specifically designed to handle temporal information in videos. It utilizes two datasets: Video-R1-CoT-165k for supervised finetuning (SFT) and Video-R1-260k for reinforcement learning (RL) training. Video-RFT [ 59 ] proposes a multi-expert driven, cognition-inspired CoT curation pipeline. In this framework, an LLM first generates preliminary CoTs based on rich, structured, and literal representations of video content. A VLM then refines these CoTs by conditioning them on the actual video input. This process results in two datasets: VideoRFT-CoT-102K for SFT and VideoRFT-RL-310K for RL training. In contrast, Video-RTS [ 64 ] presents a different approach by combining efficient RL with a video-adaptive test-time scaling (TTS) strategy. All of these works use Qwen2.5-VL-7b as the base model and continue training on this.
blocks.zh: 最近,在视频理解社区中的大量努力已经转向建立更好的视频推理模型. Video-R1 [19]引入了一种T-GRPO算法,专门用来处理视频中的时间信息. 它利用两个数据集:Video-R1-CoT-165k用于监督微调(SFT)和Video-R1-260k用于强化学习(RL)培训. 视频-RFT [59] 提出由多专家驱动,认知启发的CoT导管. 在这个框架内,LLM首先生成基于视频内容的丰富,结构化和文字化表现的初步CoT. 然后,一个VLM通过在实际的视频输入上对其进行调制,来完善这些CoT. 这个过程产生了两个数据集:用于SFT的VideoRFT-CoT-102K和用于RL培训的VideoRFT-RL-310K. 相形之下,Video-RTS[64]则通过将高效的RL与可视化的测试时间缩放(TTS)策略相结合,呈现出不同的方法. 所有这些作品都以Quen2.5-VL-7b为基准模型,并继续就此进行培训.

blocks.en: In Table 9 , we show the performance of Video-R1, Video-R2, and VideoChat-R1.5 reasoning models on VideoMME [ 21 ] dataset. It can be seen that the reasoning models provide only marginal gains over their base model, raising the concerns of necessity of such models. In Table 10 , we show the performance of MMVU (validation split, MCQ) and SciVideoBench on these three models. It can be seen that on MMVU, the highest score across all models, prompts and frame counts is achieved by the base Qwen2.5-VL-7B with a CoT prompt (68.96 at 128 frames), exceeding the best reasoning-model result (66.72, Video-R2 at 32 frames) . For SciVideoBench, the reasoning model result (Video-R1 with its own prompt, 28.8 at 64 frames) exceeds the best base-model result (27.9) by only 0.9 points.
blocks.zh: 在表9中,我们显示了Video-R1,Video-R2和VideoChat-R1.5推理模型在VideoMME [21]数据集上的性能. 可以看出,推理模型与其基础模型相比只能提供边际收益,引起人们对这些模型必要性的担忧. 在表10中,我们显示了MMVU(验证分拆,MCQ)和SciVideo Bench在这三种模型上的性能. 可以看出,在MMVU上,所有模型,提示和帧计数中最高分由基站Qwen2.5-VL-7B用COT快取(128帧为68.96分)所实现,超过了最佳推理-模型结果(66.72分,32帧为Video-R2分). 对于SciVideo Bench来说,推理模型结果(Video-R1带有自己的快取,28.8 at 64 帧)仅以0.9分就超过了最佳的基础模型结果(27.9分).
